87067eedad7f: Start an Open Bible Stories project · translationCore 4 Help
e9b53fcce663: Open Bible Stories are 50 short Bible stories, each told in numbered frames with a picture. English stories and helps come with the app.
8de4611d4bf8: On Home, click + Add a project, then New Open Bible Stories.
0c8d8237c30c: Type a Project name, the Language name and its Code.
0bbce4faf171: Choose the Text direction. Leave Checking language on English.
ff29ce607345: Click Create stories →. The new card appears on Home.
d26c5719bc33: Click a story tile (1) to open it. A new story opens in Understand.
485b6a228683: To cancel, click Cancel or the ✕. Nothing is saved.
42f5a71e6b3f: Wait a moment after clicking into a field before you type, then check what you typed. The first letters can be lost.
0322c7124fea: You can change text direction, font and checking language later in Project settings. The name and language can't be changed yet.
